mapper.select: SELECT /* getUserAlimSetting */ U.USER_NUMB , COALESCE(S.LKAL_YSNO, #{commYes}) AS LIKE_ALIM_YSNO , COALESCE(S.RPAL_YSNO, #{commYes}) AS REPLY_ALIM_YSNO , COALESCE(S.FOLL_YSNO, #{commYes}) AS FOLLOW_ALIM_YSNO , COALESCE(S.CLUB_YSNO, #{commYes}) AS CLUB_ALIM_YSNO , COALESCE(S.CHAT_YSNO, #{commYes}) AS CHAT_ALIM_YSNO , COALESCE(S.RDUE_YSNO, #{commYes}) AS REPORT_DUE_ALIM_YSNO FROM TM_USERXM U LEFT JOIN TM_USSETX S ON S.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}
SELECT /* getActiveAlimUserCnt */ COUNT(1) FROM TM_USERXM U WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND U.USER_STAT = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT /* getMyAlimList */ ALIMPAGE.USER_NUMB , ALIMPAGE.ALIM_NUMB , ALIMPAGE.ALIM_SITU , ALIMPAGE.TEMP_CODE , ALIMPAGE.ALIM_TITL , ALIMPAGE.ALIM_CONT , ALIMPAGE.READ_YSNO , ALIMPAGE.READ_DATE , ALIMPAGE.SEND_DATE , ALIMPAGE.DELT_YSNO , COALESCE(ICON.MIME_TYPE, DEFAULT_ICON.MIME_TYPE) AS ALIM_ICON_MIME_TYPE , COALESCE(ICON.ICON_DATA, DEFAULT_ICON.ICON_DATA) AS ALIM_ICON_DATA FROM ( SELECT ALIMDETAIL.USER_NUMB , ALIMDETAIL.ALIM_NUMB , ALIMDETAIL.ALIM_SITU , ALIMDETAIL.TEMP_CODE , ALIMDETAIL.ALIM_TITL , ALIMDETAIL.ALIM_CONT , ALIMDETAIL.READ_YSNO , DATE_FORMAT(ALIMDETAIL.READ_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS READ_DATE , DATE_FORMAT(ALIMDETAIL.SEND_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS SEND_DATE , ALIMDETAIL.DELT_YSNO , ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY ALIMDETAIL.SEND_DATE DESC , ALIMDETAIL.ALIM_NUMB DESC ) AS ROW_NUMB FROM ( SELECT ALIM.USER_NUMB , ALIM.ALIM_NUMB , ALIM.ALIM_SITU , ALIM.TEMP_CODE , ALIM.ALIM_TITL , ALIM.ALIM_CONT , ALIM.READ_YSNO , ALIM.READ_DATE , ALIM.SEND_DATE , ALIM.DELT_YSNO FROM TB_ALIMXX ALIM WHERE ALIM.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND COALESCE(ALIM.DELT_YSNO, #{commNo}) = #{commNo} ) ALIMDETAIL ) ALIMPAGE LEFT JOIN TM_ALICON ICON ON ICON.ALIM_SITU = ALIMPAGE.ALIM_SITU LEFT JOIN TM_ALICON DEFAULT_ICON ON DEFAULT_ICON.ALIM_SITU = #{alimSituDefault} WHERE ALIMPAGE.ROW_NUMB BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY ALIMPAGE.ROW_NUMB

SELECT /* getAlimTargetDtl */ A.USER_NUMB , A.ALIM_NUMB , A.TEMP_CODE , A.TAGT_TYPE , A.TAGT_NUMB , A.REPL_NUMB , CASE WHEN A.TAGT_TYPE = #{targetReport} THEN R.USER_NUMB WHEN A.TAGT_TYPE = #{targetUser} THEN U.USER_NUMB WHEN A.TAGT_TYPE = #{targetClub} AND A.TEMP_CODE = #{clubChatTemplate} THEN CM.USER_NUMB WHEN A.TAGT_TYPE = #{targetClub} THEN C.OWNR_NUMB ELSE I.USER_NUMB END AS TARGET_USER_NUMB , CASE WHEN A.TAGT_TYPE = #{targetReport} THEN RU.USER_STAT WHEN A.TAGT_TYPE = #{targetUser} THEN U.USER_STAT WHEN A.TAGT_TYPE = #{targetClub} AND A.TEMP_CODE = #{clubChatTemplate} THEN CMU.USER_STAT WHEN A.TAGT_TYPE = #{targetClub} THEN CU.USER_STAT ELSE I.USER_STAT END AS TARGET_USER_STAT , R.PUBC_YSNO , R.REPT_STAT , CASE WHEN F.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL THEN #{commYes} ELSE #{commNo} END AS FOLLOW_YSNO FROM TB_ALIMXX A LEFT JOIN TM_REPORT R ON A.TAGT_TYPE = #{targetReport} AND R.REPT_NUMB = A.TAGT_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM RU ON RU.USER_NUMB = R.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM I ON (A.TAGT_TYPE = #{targetProfile} AND I.PROF_NUMB = A.TAGT_NUMB) OR (A.TAGT_TYPE = #{targetBackground} AND I.BGIM_NUMB = A.TAGT_NUMB) LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM U ON A.TAGT_TYPE = #{targetUser} AND U.USER_NUMB = A.TAGT_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_CLUBXM C ON A.TAGT_TYPE = #{targetClub} AND C.CLUB_NUMB = A.TAGT_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM CU ON CU.USER_NUMB = C.OWNR_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_CLMEMX CM ON A.TAGT_TYPE = #{targetClub} AND A.TEMP_CODE = #{clubChatTemplate} AND CM.CLUB_NUMB = A.TAGT_NUMB AND CM.USER_NUMB = A.USER_NUMB AND CM.MEMB_STAT = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM CMU ON CMU.USER_NUMB = CM.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_FOLLOW F ON F.USER_NUMB = A.USER_NUMB AND F.FLOW_NUMB = CASE WHEN A.TAGT_TYPE = #{targetReport} THEN R.USER_NUMB WHEN A.TAGT_TYPE = #{targetUser} THEN U.USER_NUMB ELSE I.USER_NUMB END WHERE A.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND A.ALIM_NUMB = #{alimNumb} AND COALESCE(A.DELT_YSNO, #{commNo}) = #{commNo}
